set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset

theorem continuous_interval_preimage_closed
  {α : Type} [MetricSpace α]

  IsClosed {x : α | a ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ b} := by
  have h₁ : IsClosed {x : α | a ≤ f x} := by
    have h₂ : IsClosed {x : α | a ≤ f x} := by
      apply isClosed_Ici.preimage h
      <;> simp [le_of_lt]
    exact h₂
  
  have h₂ : IsClosed {x : α | f x ≤ b} := by
    have h₃ : IsClosed {x : α | f x ≤ b} := by
      apply isClosed_Iic.preimage h
      <;> simp [le_of_lt]
    exact h₃
  
  have h₃ : IsClosed ({x : α | a ≤ f x} ∩ {x : α | f x ≤ b}) := by
    exact IsClosed.inter h₁ h₂
  
  have h₄ : {x : α | a ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ b} = {x : α | a ≤ f x} ∩ {x : α | f x ≤ b} := by
    apply Set.ext
    intro x
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    <;>
    tauto
  
  rw [h₄]
